claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion capsule is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion capsule is scheduled to splash down at approximately 8:07 p.m. ET.
The Artemis II Orion capsule splashdown time of 8:07 p.m. ET corresponds to 5:07 p.m. PT.
The splashdown location is the Pacific Ocean approximately 40 to 70 miles west of San Diego.
Recovery teams including the U.S. Navy and NASA personnel are positioned to retrieve the four-person crew.
The crew will be transported to the USS John P. Murtha.
The capsule will be inspected following the splashdown.
The astronauts will be flown by helicopter to the U.S. Navy ship for medical checks before returning to shore.
